blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) countries on Wednesday adopted a declaration aimed at strengthening disaster resilience across the region, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said. The Manila Declaration calls for faster implementation of the Asean Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response (AADMER) Work Programme 2026–2030, stronger accountability and monitoring,
